title: Higman--Thompson groups $F_n$ all the way down
summary: We prove that for every $n\ge 2$ the Higman--Thompson group $F_n$ has a maximal subgroup of infinite index isomorphic to itself. In fact, we construct a chain of subgroups $F_n=H_0>H_1>H_2>\cdots$, all isomorphic to $F_n$ and with trivial intersection, such that for every $i$ the only subgroups of $F_n$ containing $H_i$ are $H_i,H_{i-1},\ldots,H_0=F_n$; in particular, each $H_{i+1}$ is maximal in $H_i$.
